mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT fmly_cd from tb_point_earn UNION SELECT DISTINCT fmly_cd from tb_point_using;

SELECT date_time, fmly_cd, (select cstmr_name from cstmr C where C.cstmr_cd = H.cstmr_cd) cstmr_name, point, IF(point_status='M', '사용', '적립') point_status FROM point_hist H where fmly_cd=#{fmlyCd} and point!=0 order by date_time desc, point_id desc;
SELECT point_id , sale_id , cstmr_cd , fmly_cd , point , shop_num , date_time , total_point , m_point , cstmr_point FROM point_monthly_b
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_hist (sale_id , cstmr_cd , fmly_cd , point , shop_num , date_time , point_status) VALUES (#{saleId},#{cstmrCd},#{fmlyCd},#{point},#{shopNum},#{dateTime},#{pointStatus});
mapper.select: SELECT P.point_id , P.sale_id , P.cstmr_cd , P.fmly_cd , P.point , (select shop_id from sale_off where sale_id = P.sale_id) as shop_id , P.date_time , P.point_status , M.total_point , M.m_point , M.cstmr_point FROM point_hist P inner join point_monthly_b M on P.fmly_cd = M.fmly_cd where left(P.date_time,7) <= left(M.date_time,7) order by P.fmly_cd, P.point_id desc;
mapper.insert: INSERT into point_monthly_b (point_id, sale_id, shop_num,date_time, total_point, fmly_cd, m_point,cstmr_point,cstmr_cd) SELECT F.point_id ,F.sale_id ,F.shop_num ,F.date_time ,IFNULL(C.point,0) + (IFNULL((SELECT sum(point_hist.point) FROM point_hist where point_hist.fmly_cd = F.fmly_cd and point_hist.point_status='P' and left(date_time,7) <=left(#{dateTime},7) ),0) - IFNULL((SELECT sum(point_hist.point) FROM point_hist where point_hist.fmly_cd = F.fmly_cd and point_hist.point_status='M' and left(date_time,7) <=left(#{dateTime},7) ),0)) total_point , (F.fmly_cd) fmly_cd ,F.point as m_point ,C.point ,F.cstmr_cd FROM cstmr C JOIN (SELECT point_id , sale_id , cstmr_cd , fmly_cd, sum(point) `point`, shop_num , date_time , point_status ,(select shop_name from shop where shop_id = (select shop_id from sale_off where sale_id = P.sale_id)) as shop_name FROM point_hist P WHERE point_status='M' and P.sale_id is not null and left(date_time,7) = left(#{dateTime},7) group by fmly_cd,shop_num )as F ON C.cstmr_cd = F.fmly_cd;
mapper.update: UPDATE point_trade set using_shop_id=(select shop_id from shop where shop_num=using_shop_id) where using_shop_id < 70;
UPDATE point_trade set earn_shop_id=(select shop_id from shop where shop_num=earn_shop_id) where earn_shop_id < 70;
mapper.select: SELECT (select shop_name from shop where shop_id = earn_shop_id) as earn_shop ,earn_shop_id ,(select shop_name from shop where shop_id = using_shop_id) as using_shop ,using_shop_id , sum(abs(point))*50 as point FROM point_trade T WHERE using_shop_id != earn_shop_id group by earn_shop_id, using_shop_id order by earn_shop, using_shop

SELECT (select shop_name from shop where shop_id = using_shop_id) as using_shop ,using_shop_id ,(select shop_name from shop where shop_id = earn_shop_id) as earn_shop ,earn_shop_id ,sum(abs(point))*50 as point FROM point_trade T WHERE using_shop_id != earn_shop_id group by earn_shop_id, using_shop_id order by using_shop, earn_shop

SELECT (select shop_name from shop where shop_id = earn_shop_id) as earn_shop , sum(abs(point))*50 as point FROM point_trade T WHERE using_shop_id != earn_shop_id group by earn_shop_id order by earn_shop

SELECT (select shop_name from shop where shop_id = using_shop_id) as using_shop , sum(abs(point))*50 as point FROM point_trade T WHERE using_shop_id != earn_shop_id group by using_shop_id order by using_shop
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_year (cstmr_name, fmly_cd, p_point,m_point,basic_point,current_point,inner_point) SELECT cstmr_name ,H.fmly_cd ,sum(IF(H.point_status='P',IFNULL(H.point,0),0)) as P ,sum(IF(H.point_status='M',IFNULL(H.point,0),0)) as M ,C.point ,C.point + (sum(IF(H.point_status='P',IFNULL(H.point,0),0))) - (sum(IF(H.point_status='M',IFNULL(H.point,0),0))) as sum_point ,sum(IF(H.point_status='P' and (H.date_time > #{tgtDate}),IFNULL(H.point,0),0)) as inner_point FROM point_hist H INNER JOIN cstmr C ON H.fmly_cd = C.cstmr_cd WHERE H.point!=0 group by fmly_cd;

INSERT INTO point_hist (point_id ,sale_id ,cstmr_cd ,fmly_cd ,point ,shop_num ,date_time ,point_status) SELECT NULL ,NULL ,'expired' ,fmly_cd ,(current_point - inner_point) as del_point ,0 ,#{crtDate} ,'M' FROM point_year where current_point - inner_point > 0
